text_block_list.name: ECG Beep
text_block_list.text: (Beep, beep, beep, beep...)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(A white bed, the smell of antiseptic.
—Whenever I see this hospital room, everything is always so sterile.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(And my elementary school homeroom teacher
is still sleeping in the bed in this room today.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Taking a midday nap, Sensei?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no answer from sensei.
All I can hear is the quiet sound of peaceful breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, look at you enjoying yourself. ...Well then, I'm just gonna go ahead and talk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, Sensei and I...
we've known each other for quite a long time, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Sensei was always ridiculously serious.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Haa... haa... Hold on a second!"

text_block_list.name: Brat A
text_block_list.text:
“—Ugh. That woman's back again.
Nakayama, you gotta do something about her!”

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
"Hah? I'm troubled here too.
What is that teacher's deal anyway...?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (Back in elementary school, I used to do tests of courage all the time with the kids around the neighborhood.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Leaping from the highest point in the park,
or challenging adults to games of tag)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (And as we fooled around in broad daylight, everyone around gave us cold looks, keeping their distance and never approaching.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: (And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "Hey! Stop doing dangerous things!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though there was no way she could ever catch up to us when we gave it our all,
Sensei would just keep chasing after us forever."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...And then the next day,
she gave me an absolute earful at school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Why do you keep putting yourself in danger?
What were you going to do if you got hurt?!"

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
"Shut up... It's my body,
so how I use it is my business, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: "What a shame, though. With legs like yours, you could be doing something far more thrilling."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you love thrilling excitement that much,
then try taking on a match where you're pushed even closer to the brink.
With those legs of yours."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I enrolled.
Into Tracen Academy. To compete on the razor's edge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
To the stage where the greatest race unfolds...
I have arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And she even teamed up with some eccentric Trainer who said, "We're gonna conquer the world together."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Doc.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Here's what I think. Gambling is all about making choices.
A single choice can end up deciding your whole life."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My hands back then will probably be sickeningly slick with sweat.
Panicked, confused, lost. And then I—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —It makes me feel the worst, and the absolute best.

Starting today, training for the Twinkle Series
with Nakayama Festa begins!

On this day, in order to assemble a training regimen, I was reviewing past footage of the girl I was to train.
Currently playing on the TV was—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha!! That's it, don't hold back.
THAT'S what I've been looking for!"

text_block_list.name: French Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...! ...AAAAAAAHHH!!"

"...Before she met me, Nakayama Festa
had competed against foreign Umamusume
in unofficial street races."
choice_data_list: (And against a much higher-tier opponent, too...)

text_block_list.text:
Normally, there'd be no chance of winning.
The harder you run, the more you realize the gap between you and your opponent, feeling absolute despair in a race like that—
The Umamusume known as Nakayama Festa "enjoyed" even adversity itself as just another element to get her blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
""...Aargh! Shut up!
Shut up, shut up! My heart is pounding like an idiot!
Ha ha, I am—""

Seeing her dig in her heels on the poorly maintained turf
without losing her footing, I thought to myself:
Her running style is—
choice_data_list: (...That's a run that can conquer the world)

text_block_list.text: ...Any Trainer who watches this footage would undoubtedly come to the same conviction.
choice_data_list: ...Alright, time to get ready for training!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's the one from the rumors...!
The one who picked a fight with El Condor Pasa...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that Trainer a rookie?
They probably haven't even laid the groundwork for the world stage yet...
I wonder if they're truly facing reality?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Trainer.
What're you standing around for?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, what's with that look?
You think you're some kinda kitten or somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ......*sigh*. Don't tell me you're getting overwhelmed by the reporters and feeling nervous now, of all times... right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: The situation we're in right now is the result of your choice to pick me.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...! Isn't that
El Condor Pasa over there!?
El Condor Pasa... She is a legendary Umamusume who placed second in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, one of the premier races that determines the world's best.
choice_data_list: (In other words... the Umamusume closest to the world.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
To think THE El Condor Pasa
would come watch an un-debuted Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't she really dislike that girl?
I mean, she barged right into the press conference...
See?! It turned into a huge issue!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... the press conference, that did happen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"—Barging in and issuing a challenge...
Do you understand the weight of your actions?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
""Yeah. And that right you carry to take on
the world—you can just hand it over
to me, El.""

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...The one who can make meaningful use
of that ticket isn't someone who's already finished competing and become part of the past—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: “—It's me.”

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —...All because I went and made a remark like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: By the way, who was it that pushed me to do that in the first place?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Why are you taking that so seriously?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret making that declaration.
Even though I got thoroughly beaten by El in the race after that.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: I see. So that's the big mouth El Condor Pasa has her eye on...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Win or lose, writing an article about this is gonna get crazy views.
...Better draft it now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, we stole the spotlight from prying eyes.
We certainly backed ourselves into a tight corner with that bold move, too.
choice_data_list: Looks like the debut race is gonna be a nail-biter, too.
Looks like your debut race will be a thrilling contest too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Ever since I teamed up with you,
I've been having the absolute—best time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoops, guess I should get to training. No use draggin' out the small talk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though it's no fun just starting things normally.
So here's the deal, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "How about it? How about we put our post-lunch ice cream money on the line and make a bet?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The subject of the bet is my legs.
My final split time... whether I can run the final furlong—200 meters—
in under 12 seconds or not.
"Based on average data for pre-debut Umamusume at this time of year, she'd clock in the high 12s... so maybe low 12s at best. But—"
choice_data_list: If it's you, I'd bet on "you can do it".
If it's you, I want to bet that you "can do it."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, whoa there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Did'ja know?
If both of ya bet on the exact same thing, the bet is off!
And so, the Twinkle Series alongside the gambler Umamusume, Nakayama Festa, began!
